title: Kandy Esala Perahera — official historical and ritual narrative
author_or_institution: Media Bureau of Sri Dalada Maligawa / Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
scope: First-party institutional account of the Tooth Relic, Dalada Perahera, royal guardianship/legitimacy, relocation to Kandy under Wimaladharmasuriya I, and continuity/reorganisation of the Perahera after the British takeover of 1815.
limitations: Authoritative for the Temple's current institutional tradition and ritual self-understanding, not an independent primary witness for events in 310 CE or for uninterrupted continuity across every medieval capital. Historical chronology and strong sovereignty formulas require epigraphic, archival or academic corroboration.
